posts.series_brief: Showcase (the slot's `series`: 'Kenya at its best' = a real Kenyan place at its most beautiful: a park, lake, mountain, coast, city view; 'Built in Kenya' = a real, finished and working public project: a road, bridge, power plant, railway, hospital, market). `place` where it is (max 40, e.g. 'Hell's Gate, Naivasha'), `line` the headline: one plain, proud sentence with one *marker* (max 110), `fact` one sourced detail a Kenyan may not know (size, year opened, what it carries or produces, max 150), `source` required: the official page for the fact (KWS, KFS, KeNHA, KURA, Kenya Railways, KenGen, UNESCO, a county or ministry page) as its full web address, NEVER a headline id unless the post is about that news story; `photo_query` REQUIRED: the place or project itself by its real name plus 'Kenya' (e.g. 'Hell's Gate National Park Kenya', 'Nairobi Expressway Kenya'). Only projects that are finished and in use; nothing stalled, nothing promised. No politician is credited by name. `beats` 3 sentences: the place and why it is worth seeing, the fact, and where it is or how to visit or use it.

scripts.radio:
Habari za wiki, nchi yangu. Karibu kwenye Kenya on Record. Hii ndiyo nafasi yetu ya kudadisi ukweli nyuma ya kelele za mtaani.

Tunaanza na uongo uliosambaa wiki hii: kuna front page ya gazeti iliyokuwa viral ikidai Fred Matiang'i ndiye anaongoza kwenye kura za maoni. Wakenya, hiyo picha ni bandia kabisa. Tusikubali kupotoshwa na propaganda za mitandaoni kabla ya uchaguzi.

Kwenye habari njema, sekta yetu ya nishati inang’aa. Vituo vya umeme wa joto ardhi vya Olkaria vimezalisha megawati mia saba na kumi na tatu (713 MW) kutoka kwenye joto la dunia. Hii inamaanisha nishati safi na ya kuaminika kwa uchumi wetu.

Lakini kwenye upande wa biashara, hali si shwari. Utafiti unaonyesha asilimia arobaini na nane (48%) ya kampuni za kadiri hapa nchini zilikumbana na vitisho au madai ya hongo mwaka huu. Rushwa inaendelea kuua ukuaji wa biashara zetu.

Mwisho kabisa, bajeti ya 2027/28 inatayarishwa. Je, umetoa maoni yako kuhusu jinsi pesa za umma zitakavyotumika? Sauti yako ni muhimu.

*Kwa ufupi:* Gazeti la Matiang'i kuongoza kura ni feki. Olkaria imezalisha 713MW za umeme. Asilimia 48 ya kampuni za kadiri zimelalamikia hongo mwaka huu, na wananchi wanahimizwa kutoa maoni kuhusu bajeti ya 2027/28.
scripts.voice_note: Wadau, mambo vipi? Hapa ni Kenya on Record na dondoo za wiki hii. Kwanza kabisa, ile front page inayozunguka mitandaoni ikidai Fred Matiang'i anaongoza kura za maoni ni feki mtupu—msidanganywe. Habari nzuri ni kwamba Olkaria imetupatia megawati 713 za umeme safi kutoka chini ya ardhi. Lakini upande wa pili, biashara zetu zinateseka; asilimia 48 ya kampuni za kadiri zimeripoti kukumbana na rushwa mwaka huu. Kumbuka pia kutoa maoni yako kwenye bajeti ya 2027/28. Simama kidete,dai ukweli!
scripts.sms: Usiibiwe: Picha ya gazeti inayodai Matiang'i anaongoza kura ni feki. Usambaze uongo. Toa maoni yako kwenye bajeti ya 2027/28. Kenya on Record.
scripts.reels: [Picha ya front page feki ikichanwa] Wakenya, msidanganywe na hii!
